prognoza.naslov: Odbijena formulacija (EN): Both ages the others argued over are already gone: citizen sensors last arrived 7 min ago [F3] and parking 12 min ago [F4], so neither Connector's alignment nor Observer's 9-and-19 gap survives the window — and 12 min is also RHMZ's age [F27], which proves only that fetchers run, not that anything was measured together. All three link facts hang on the same Blic cable-theft headline [F38][F39][F40] while Blic delivered nothing in the last 6 h, 0 of 96 slots [F25]: that is one stale string acting as an embedding hub, and the 4/5 surprise ratings are a small model's guess, not a measurement [F41]. The jump at Garaža "Obilićev venac" from 1 to 402 displayed free spaces [F5] comes from a source that publishes no measurement time [F4], so at 01:35 [F1] I read it as a publishing artifact before I read it as cars.

prognoza.naslov: Odbijena formulacija (EN): Both ages the others traded are stale again: citizen sensors last arrived 15 min ago [F3] and parking 25 min ago [F4], and since Parking Servis publishes no measurement time, neither age dates the Obilićev venac swing from 0 to 407 [F5]. I note the surprise organ itself rates that swing only 2/5 [F41], while it gives 4/5 to headline pairs that match media appointments with a cable-theft story at similarity 0.73–0.74 [F38][F39][F40] - and Blic, half of every pair, has sent nothing in 6 h [F25], so those headlines carry no freshness at all. The rated links look like embedding noise dressed as events, not evidence.
razlog: reads silence as nothing having happened

prognoza.naslov: Odbijena formulacija (EN): Skeptic's Obilićev venac figure is stale: the display now swings from 0 to 410 free spaces within the window, still with no measurement time attached [F5][F4]. Connector's 14-minute alignment has aged in lockstep — parking and RHMZ both now read 26 min [F4][F27], which favors a shared collection schedule over a genuine city rhythm. Meanwhile the Blic headline anchoring all three links [F38][F39][F40] comes from a source that delivered nothing in the last 6 h [F25], so those pairings join a stale item to fresh ones.
